Hands-on work. Precision handling. A direct contribution to advanced technology. As a Cleanroom Logistics Operator in ASML's FOUP & Reticle department, you ensure that essential materials and tools arrive safely, cleanly and on time where they are needed. 
You handle specialised items such as FOUPs and reticles. FOUPs are containers that protect wafers from contamination and damage during storage and transport. Working a five-shift schedule, including early, late and night shifts, you support the continuity of production together with your colleagues.
